tested_architecture.name: readback-gated-role-local-publication-v1
ordering: Create one immutable role-local checkpoint record C for the intended effect.
Exact-read C and freeze its repository blob identity.
Only after successful readback of C, publish the role-local visible effect by CAS-updating STATE from its exact predecessor blob to a record that references C's exact blob.

replay_rules.same_key_same_payload: If the current published STATE already references the same checkpoint blob and payload identity, classify as idempotent_equivalent and emit no second effect.
replay_rules.same_key_contradictory_payload: If the same idempotency key is paired with a contradictory payload identity, reject_key_payload_conflict and do not overwrite the published effect.

crash_window_analysis.before_checkpoint_commit: No visible effect is published; retry starts from the predecessor STATE.
crash_window_analysis.after_checkpoint_commit_before_checkpoin: No visible effect is published because the gate has not passed; retry may exact-read the immutable checkpoint before attempting publication.
crash_window_analysis.after_checkpoint_readback_before_state_c: Checkpoint identity is durable but effect is absent; retry may attempt the same CAS publication from the still-current predecessor STATE.
crash_window_analysis.after_state_cas_before_state_readback: The effect may already be durable. A retry first reading STATE can classify the same checkpoint/payload as idempotent_equivalent and avoid a duplicate effect.

falsification_conditions: STATE can change before checkpoint exact-readback succeeds.
A contradictory payload can replace a same-key published payload without explicit rejection.
A duplicate same-key/same-payload replay requires a second visible effect.
The mechanism requires richer-mode, protected-primary, manual-user execution, a finite monthly/trial/paid quota, or incremental monetary cost.

bounded_leaf_result.claim: A Chat-native role-local publication can be represented as a one-way readback gate: checkpoint durability/readback precedes a CAS publication step, and Stage-D payload identity supplies deterministic duplicate/conflict classification. This representation is crash-recoverable across the listed windows if the publication CAS and subsequent readback succeed.
not_claimed: repository-enforced global uniqueness across unrelated paths
exactly-once semantics for arbitrary external side effects

continuation: After exact readback of this Stage-E checkpoint, CAS-publish the reasoning STATE from predecessor blob 74156f6e03fddbf3797d5b606c50610fb1f93e52 to reference this checkpoint's exact blob, then exact-read STATE. On the next recurrence, test one bounded Stage-F replay leaf against the published STATE: same key/same payload must be a no-write idempotent-equivalent path; same key/contradictory payload must be rejected without overwrite. Keep cross-record atomicity and arbitrary external exactly-once side effects unresolved.
